```{r, echo=FALSE}


## Loading libraries
suppressWarnings(library(pacman))

suppressWarnings(p_load("tidyverse", 
       "Biostrings", 
       "dplyr", 
       "stringr",
       "renv",
       "DT", "data.table", "htmltools", "openxlsx"))

suppressWarnings(library(htmltools))


```


```{r, echo=FALSE}

# Set working directory one level up
setwd("../")

# Extract the folder name from the working directory
Run_ID <- basename(getwd())

# Create a single-row data frame with the Run_ID
foldername <- data.frame(Run_ID = Run_ID)

# Display in a datatable
DT::datatable(
  foldername,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(
    paging = FALSE,
    searching = FALSE,
    ordering = FALSE,
    info = FALSE,
    editable = 'row',
    dom = 't'  # Just show the table body
  )
)

```

## Sample IDs

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

# Dynamically read Sample_IDs file
sample_file <- list.files("./Sample_IDs", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)[1]

if (!is.na(sample_file)) {
  sample_names <- read.csv(sample_file)
  colnames(sample_names) <- "Sample_IDs"

  DT::datatable(
    sample_names,
    options = list(paging = F, autoWidth = F, scrollX = F),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
} else {
  cat("<div style='color: red;'>⚠️ No CSV file found in ./Sample_IDs/</div>")
}

```

## Exon Deletions

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Dynamically load from NovelSplices folder
splice_file <- list.files("./NovelSplices", pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)[1]

if (!is.na(splice_file)) {
  SpliceChaser <- read.xlsx(splice_file)

  old_colnames <- colnames(SpliceChaser)
  start_index <- which(old_colnames == "#PatientsWithVarCall")
  cols_to_rename <- old_colnames[start_index:length(old_colnames)]

  new_names <- str_remove(cols_to_rename, "^unique_count_")
  new_names <- str_remove(new_names, "_S\\d+_trimmed\\.star\\.hg38_result_final\\.csv$") %>%
    sub("_20[0-9]{6}$", "", .)

  colnames(SpliceChaser)[start_index:length(old_colnames)] <- new_names
  colnames(SpliceChaser)[as.numeric(length(colnames(SpliceChaser)))] -> lst_col

  SpliceChaser %>%
    dplyr::relocate(delSize, intronMotif, nExSkip, exon, .after = all_of(lst_col)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(`#pts` = `#PatientsWithVarCall`, gene = geneName) -> SpliceChaser

  htmltools::tagList(
    tags$div(
      id = "Splice-table-wrapper",
      HTML("<style>#Splice-table-wrapper table.dataTable td.dt-separator { border-right: 2px solid #999; }</style>"),
      DT::datatable(
        SpliceChaser,
        extensions = c("Buttons", "FixedHeader", "FixedColumns"),
        options = list(
          dom = 'Bfrtip',
          buttons = list('copy','excel', list(extend = 'colvis', text = 'Show/Hide Columns')),
          paging = FALSE,
          autoWidth = F,
          scrollX = TRUE,
          fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 6),
          fixedHeader = TRUE,
          columnDefs = list(
            list(visible = FALSE, targets = which(names(SpliceChaser) %in% c("delSize", "intronMotif", "nExSkip", "exon")) - 1),
            list(targets = 5, className = "dt-separator")
          )
        ),
        rownames = FALSE,
        class = 'cell-border stripe hover nowrap',
        escape = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("<div style='color: red;'>⚠️ No .xlsx file found in ./NovelSplices/</div>")
}


```

## Fusions
####### TR : Translocation
####### DEL : Deletion
####### DUP : Duplication
####### INV : Inversion

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Dynamically load from Arriba_Fusions folder
arriba_file <- list.files("./Arriba_Fusions", pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)[1]

if (!is.na(arriba_file)) {
  Arriba <- read.xlsx(arriba_file)

  old_colnames <- colnames(Arriba)
  start_index <- which(old_colnames == "#PatientsWithVarCall")
  cols_to_rename <- old_colnames[start_index:length(old_colnames)]

  new_names <- str_remove(cols_to_rename, "^avg_read_count_")
  new_names <- str_remove(new_names, "_S\\d+_trimmed\\.star\\.hg38\\._arriba_final\\.csv$") %>%
    sub("_20[0-9]{6}$", "", .)

  colnames(Arriba)[start_index:length(old_colnames)] <- new_names

  Arriba <- Arriba%>%
    dplyr::rename(Chr1 = chrom1, Chr2 = chrom2, gene1 = gene_id1, gene2 = gene_id2, `#pts` = `#PatientsWithVarCall`) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(type, .before = `#pts`)

  col_defs <- lapply(length(colnames(Arriba)), function(idx) {
    list(targets = 9, className = "dt-separator")
  })

  htmltools::tagList(
    tags$div(
      id = "fusion-table-wrapper",
      HTML("<style>#fusion-table-wrapper table.dataTable td.dt-separator { border-right: 2px solid #999; }</style>"),
      DT::datatable(
        Arriba,
        extensions = c("Buttons", "FixedHeader", "FixedColumns"),
        options = list(
          dom = 'Bfrtip',
          buttons = list('copy', 'excel'),
          paging = FALSE,
          autoWidth = TRUE,
          scrollX = TRUE,
          fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 10),
          fixedHeader = TRUE,
          columnDefs = col_defs
        ),
        rownames = FALSE,
        class = 'cell-border stripe hover nowrap'
      )
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("<div style='color: red;'>⚠️ No .xlsx file found in ./Arriba_Fusions/</div>")
}

```

## Mutations
####### Three columns for each patient, and each column represents:
####### 1st column: Total Depth
####### 2nd column: Allele Depth
####### 3rd column: Allele Frequency (%)

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
variant_file <- list.files("./Variants", pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)[1]

if (!is.na(variant_file)) {
  Variants <- read.xlsx(variant_file)

  af_cols <- grep("^AF\\.", colnames(Variants), value = TRUE)
  # Variants[ , af_cols] <- round(Variants[ , af_cols] * 100, 1)

  Variants$`#pts` <- rowSums(!is.na(Variants[af_cols]) & Variants[af_cols] > 0)
  Variants <- Variants %>% relocate(`#pts`, .after = p.HGVS)

  start_index <- which(colnames(Variants) == "#pts")
  cols_to_rename <- colnames(Variants)[start_index:length(colnames(Variants))]
  new_names <- sub("_20[0-9]{6}$", "", cols_to_rename)
  colnames(Variants)[start_index:length(colnames(Variants))] <- new_names

  if ("Chrom" %in% colnames(Variants)) {
    Variants <- Variants %>% dplyr::rename(Chr = Chrom)
  }

  fixed_cols <- c("Chr", "Pos", "Gene", "c.HGVS", "p.HGVS", "#pts")
  ad_cols <- grep("^AD\\.", colnames(Variants), value = TRUE)
  dp_cols <- grep("^DP\\.", colnames(Variants), value = TRUE)
  af_cols <- grep("^AF\\.", colnames(Variants), value = TRUE)

  # Extract raw IDs from AD. columns
  sample_ids <- gsub("^AD\\.", "", ad_cols)

  # Build sample column order (DP, AD, AF for each sample)
  sample_cols <- unlist(lapply(sample_ids, function(id) {
    c(paste0("DP.", id), paste0("AD.", id), paste0("AF.", id))
  }))

  new_order <- c(fixed_cols, sample_cols)
  new_order <- new_order[new_order %in% colnames(Variants)]
  Variants <- Variants[, new_order]

  # Rename headers: remove DP./AD./AF. and keep only sample IDs
  pretty_colnames <- colnames(Variants)
  pretty_colnames <- gsub("^(DP|AD|AF)\\.", "", pretty_colnames)
  
  # Keep only the portion like "06_01_AMR"
  pretty_colnames <- sub("^(\\d{2}_\\d{2}_[A-Z]+).*", "\\1", pretty_colnames)

  all_cols <- colnames(Variants)
  sample_start_idx <- which(all_cols == paste0("DP.", sample_ids[1]))
  separator_indices <- seq(sample_start_idx + 2, length(all_cols), by = 3)
  col_defs <- lapply(separator_indices, function(idx) {
    list(targets = c(5, idx - 1), className = "dt-separator")
  })

  # Indices of sample columns for header coloring (1-based)
  sample_col_indices_1based <- which(colnames(Variants) %in% sample_cols)

  # Group sample columns by patient: every 3 columns correspond to one patient
  num_patients <- length(sample_ids)
  color_classes <- c("sample-header-blue", "sample-header-red")

  # Create a list to hold columnDefs for header colors, alternating colors
  color_col_defs <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(num_patients)) {
    patient_cols <- ((i-1)*3 + 1):((i-1)*3 + 3)
    cols_i <- sample_col_indices_1based[patient_cols]
    cols_i_0based <- cols_i - 1
    color_class <- color_classes[(i %% 2) + 1]
    color_col_defs[[i]] <- list(
      targets = cols_i_0based,
      className = color_class
    )
  }

  # Combine with existing col_defs (like dt-separator)
  all_col_defs <- c(col_defs, color_col_defs)

  htmltools::tagList(
    tags$style(HTML("
      table.dataTable thead th.sample-header-blue {
        background-color: #1f77b4 !important;
        color: white !important;
        border: 1px solid #999 !important;
      }
      table.dataTable thead th.sample-header-red {
        background-color: #d62728 !important;
        color: white !important;
        border: 1px solid #999 !important;
      }
      #variants-table-wrapper table.dataTable td.dt-separator {
        border-right: 2px solid #999;
      }
    ")),
    tags$div(
      id = "variants-table-wrapper",
      DT::datatable(
        Variants,
        colnames = pretty_colnames,
        extensions = c("Buttons", "FixedHeader", "FixedColumns"),
        options = list(
          dom = 'Bfrtip',
          buttons = list('copy', 'excel'),
          paging = FALSE,
          autoWidth = FALSE,
          scrollX = TRUE,
          fixedHeader = TRUE,
          fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 6),
          columnDefs = all_col_defs
        ),
        rownames = FALSE,
        class = 'cell-border stripe hover nowrap',
        escape = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("<div style='color: red;'>⚠️ No Excel file found in ./Variants/</div>")
}





```
